scope: Full He-Xiong equity and explicitly smoothed first-hit risk compiled for float32 neural-state training
financial_parameters: Fixed per compiled template; NOT trainable through the lookup table
risk: C1 cubic Hermite patch of original F in 0<x<0.02*sigma*sqrt(maturity), with F(0)=1 and Fprime(0)=0; original F outside the boundary layer
danger_extension: With s=sigma*sqrt(maturity), q(z)=0.5*Fpatched(s*abs(z)) for z<0, 1-0.5*Fpatched(s*abs(z)) for z>=0; this is a new neural design, not the original financial put
table: Float64 original financial formulas -> monotone C1 cubic interpolation -> float32 coefficients
tails: Explicit bounded exponential extensions matching value and first derivative; approximation error checked separately
boundary_layer_bias: Reported separately from numerical error; smoothing changes the original F inside the layer
precision_interpretation: New normalized-neural-kernel tolerances, not a revision or pass of the prior raw financial float32 test
validation_plan: All piecewise joins including boundary and tails
